title: Kado Digital cinematic website
summary: The studio’s own black-and-orange cinematic portfolio, with scroll-driven storytelling and a configurable website concept.
details: Static HTML, CSS and JavaScript hosted on Cloudflare Pages
Responsive scroll scenes with reduced-motion fallbacks
A live website customizer demonstrating design directions
story: Our own website is the studio’s public proof of craft: a minimalist geometric cat identity, cinematic scroll treatment, accessible navigation and a working website-design demonstrator.
approach: The experience is deliberately dependency-light. It is built with semantic HTML, responsive CSS and small vanilla-JavaScript modules, then deployed automatically from GitHub to Cloudflare Pages.
outcome: Live public studio website. The interactive website customizer is a demonstration, not a client deployment.

title: MemeLife
summary: A mobile merge game built in Godot, Kado Digital’s first original game.
details: Tap producers to create mergeable items, then combine chains to progress
Level-based unlocks and a character timeline spanning early internet culture to modern social apps
Godot 4.x content experiments; commercial game source and launch still being finalized
outcome: Prototype stage. The full Godot game source is not currently available in the public portfolio, and no app-store release is claimed.
story: A playful mobile merging game built around growing up with internet culture. The experience explores item chains, character evolution and a progression system designed for quick sessions.
approach: Godot 4.x is the target engine. The design includes an expandable merge board, producers, level rewards, an evolving cast and opt-in rewarded ads. A standalone technology-content lab exists, but it is not the complete game.

title: Photo Cleaner
summary: A local-first Flutter app for clearing out a photo library quickly, without ever deleting by accident.
details: Swipe to keep or queue; deletion never happens without explicit confirmation
Local-first duplicate and similarity analysis, with attention to faces and sensitive documents
Optional monetization at natural breaks without interrupting or blocking progress
outcome: Prototype/development stage. The GitHub repository does not currently contain the complete app source, and no store release is claimed.
story: A photo-cleanup workflow built around quick decisions and deliberate control. Swipe right to keep, swipe left to queue for deletion, then review everything before deleting.
approach: Flutter is the intended mobile stack. The design prioritizes authorized photo-library access, on-device analysis where practical, duplicate/similar-photo grouping and safeguards for sensitive images.

title: MemeLife cinematic website
summary: The companion website for MemeLife: pinned full-screen scenes, layered parallax and scroll-directed storytelling.
details: Story-driven sequences, from personal computers and messenger apps to the smartphone era
Layered WebP artwork and scroll-controlled transitions
Still a project website concept, not proof that the mobile game has launched
outcome: A website prototype with multiple illustrated scenes; additional assets and launch review remain in progress.
story: A scroll-driven promotional concept tracing technology and internet culture across a lifetime, using parallax and layered illustrated scenes.
approach: A static HTML, CSS and JavaScript site layers backgrounds, characters and foregrounds. Motion is tied to native scroll, with mobile and reduced-motion considerations.

title: Algorithm Lab
summary: Interactive scientific-computing demonstrations for optimization benchmarks, optimal transport, and ChiMerge discretization.
details: Optimization benchmark landscapes for Ackley, Rastrigin, Griewank and Quadric
Transport plans, distribution interpolation and synthetic adaptation examples
ChiMerge interval boundaries on an abalone data set
outcome: Public source repository with reproducible numerical demonstrations and test coverage.
story: A Django-based portfolio of numerical computing experiments combining optimization landscapes, optimal transport demonstrations and ChiMerge discretization.
approach: The application unifies three earlier histories, exposes visual modules and provides reproducible local development with Docker and automated tests.
imageAlt: Illustrative 3D Rastrigin optimization landscape, a function studied in Algorithm Lab; not an application screenshot

title: AWS Python examples
summary: Small public Python and Boto3 exercises illustrating AWS automation and data workflows.
details: Educational AWS scripting exercises
Python with Boto3
Personal practice, not customer infrastructure
story: A focused collection of AWS practice exercises and Python automation ideas.
approach: Small scripts provide a sandbox for understanding cloud SDK operations and basic automations without exposing real customer environments.
outcome: Public personal practice repository; no commercial product or service-level claims.

title: Cloud infrastructure and RAG systems
summary: Experience from Mobina’s professional role in AWS cloud engineering and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Described as skills only: no employer or customer systems, names or details are shown, and this work is not Kado Digital property.
details: AWS cloud operations, automation and incident troubleshooting
Full-stack support and observability
RAG-related engineering experience, described at a high level
outcome: Experience summary only. No employer-owned implementation, customer data, confidential architecture or private source is presented.
story: An overview of technologies applied in professional employment, not a Kado Digital product or company-owned case study.
approach: Cloud administration includes monitoring, troubleshooting, AWS operations and exposure to application delivery and retrieval-augmented generation systems.

title: Custom business website platform (prototype)
summary: A role-based web application prototype for content management, client communications and project quoting.
details: Role-based content management, approvals and revisions
Quotes and customer-owned records with access controls
Security-oriented prototype requiring production hardening
outcome: Private technical prototype. Not production-certified and not marketed as an active hosted client portal.
story: A role-based web application experiment exploring a public company website with editorial tools, quotation workflows and client-facing records.
approach: React frontend with FastAPI, SQLAlchemy and PostgreSQL backend. Role boundaries for admin, writer and client are enforced server-side rather than only through the UI.

title: Django Boards
summary: A Django discussion-board application with environment-based security, health checks, tests, CI, and containerization.
details: Boards, topics and admin functionality using the Django ORM
Runtime security settings, health endpoint and deployment checks
Docker Compose and GitHub Actions automation
outcome: Public learning project with a hardened development/deployment example; not presented as a paid client product.
story: A discussion-board application updated around production-minded Django conventions and a clear separation of settings and web routes.
approach: Django ORM, admin and tests are paired with Gunicorn, WhiteNoise, environment-backed security and Docker workflows.

title: Designe Flooring Studio (website concept)
summary: A customizable React website concept for a premium flooring and interior-design business, designed as a portfolio demonstration.
details: Multi-page frontend with materials, services, project pages and consultations
Responsive React components and themed presentation
Illustrative business content, explicitly not customer work
outcome: Private portfolio concept—not a real customer launch or a completed client contract.
story: A React website concept for a premium flooring and interior-design brand, created as a sample of multi-page presentation and navigation patterns.
approach: React Router and Ant Design support service pages, materials, project listings and contact/consultation interactions. The forms use mailto handoff rather than a backend.

title: Parse Platform
summary: Multilingual full-stack starter with a typed data-filter builder, Parse API, health checks, and Dockerized development.
details: Typed data-filter builder for strings, numbers, dates and booleans
React 18 + Express/Parse Server API with MongoDB persistence
Developer-focused Docker setup, health checks and automated tests
outcome: Public source intended as a developer starter; production permissions and credentials must be configured before real-world use.
story: A consolidated full-stack starter built with React, Express, Parse Server and MongoDB. It combines earlier frontend, backend and query-building experiments.
approach: The project includes a typed React data-filter builder, multilingual frontend, Parse API, health checks, CI and Docker-based local development.

title: Speech emotion recognition research
summary: Graduate research exploring Conformer networks and pretrained speech representations for speech emotion recognition.
details: Research into spoken emotion classification and acoustic representations
Conformer architecture and pretrained audio representation experiments
Graduate research, not a public clinical or production system
story: Master’s-level investigation of how models can learn emotional cues in speech from time-dependent acoustic features and representations.
approach: The research focused on Conformer-based modeling and pretrained speech representations, with experimentation and evaluation in an academic setting.
outcome: Graduate research. No peer-reviewed publication or production deployment is claimed.

title: VS Code AI coding assistant
summary: An experimental multi-agent coding assistant for Visual Studio Code. A personal research project, not a published extension.
details: Plan → implement → independently review in a controlled Git worktree
Fallback behavior for some quota/auth/transient failures with safety stops after partial edits
SecretStorage for provider keys; manual verification remains essential
outcome: Experimental v0.3.0 source is public; not a published Marketplace extension or a guarantee of supported provider APIs.
story: A personal VS Code extension exploring what happens when one coding task flows through planning, implementation and an independent review.
approach: Provider integrations aim for official tools and authenticated interfaces. A Git worktree is used for implementation so unfinished edits do not silently contaminate the main working copy.
